title: Muse Sputter

hardware.nvidia_smi: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060, 610.88, 8192 MiB, 3792 MiB, 55, 1252 MHz, 5001 MHz, 31.83 W

comparison: Local PyTorch torch.mm vs deliberately fragmented PyTorch projection on the same RTX 3060. This is not SGLang, H200, a whole-model benchmark, or an official OKC result.

method.timing: CUDA event nodes captured inside each CUDA graph; no fixed-overhead subtraction
method.ordering: baseline first on even pairs, parody first on odd pairs
method.fresh_inputs: 4 distinct seeded input tensors rotate across pairs; the same tensor is used for both sides of a pair
method.cache: 128 MiB write flush before each side, outside timing; not the judge's exact read-flush protocol
method.clock_control: Unchanged; shared Windows desktop GPU; no exclusive-GPU or clock-lock claim

summary.formula: For each load: sum(weight * parody median time) / sum(weight * baseline median time). Geometric mean across loads.

ending_hardware.nvidia_smi: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060, 610.88, 8192 MiB, 5239 MiB, 59, 1957 MHz, 7301 MHz, 67.80 W
